archetypes.name: Ring
archetypes.what: Defences arranged in a circle around the Town Hall, so troops walk the perimeter instead of driving in.
archetypes.good_at: Spam attacks. Reliably holds attackers to one star.

archetypes.name: Island
archetypes.what: Key defences separated into small isolated pockets, each needing its own troops or spells.
archetypes.good_at: Forcing an attacker to spend spells early, and punishing a single push.

archetypes.name: Compartment
archetypes.what: Walls divide the base into rooms, so a breach in one does not open the rest.
archetypes.good_at: Breaking troop flow; at high town halls this causes time fails.

archetypes.name: Anti-two-star
archetypes.what: Town Hall dead centre and protected at all costs; conceding damage to keep the hall.

archetypes.name: Anti-three-star
archetypes.what: Denies 100%. The Town Hall is deliberately less protected than in an anti-two.
archetypes.good_at: War and CWL, where the third star is what matters.

giant_archer.name: Giants + Archers
giant_archer.note: Giants tank, Archers clean up; Wall Breakers once Mortars matter.

balloon_early.name: Balloons
balloon_early.note: Strong where anti-air coverage is still thin.

giant_healer.name: Giant push with Healers
giant_healer.note: Heal Spell and Healers make a sustained Giant tankline reliable.

zap_dragon.name: Zap Dragons
zap_dragon.note: Lightning the Air Defenses, attack from behind the Air Sweeper, spread Dragons on a flat side.

drag_lavaloon.name: Dragon LavaLoon
drag_lavaloon.note: Funnel for Dragons, then Lava Hound and Balloons into the core.

queen_charge_lalo.name: Queen Charge LavaLoon
queen_charge_lalo.note: Queen charge clears key Air Defenses or heroes first.

super_hogs.name: Super Hogs
super_hogs.note: Effective against both ring and compartment bases.

root_rider_ground.name: Root Rider ground
root_rider_ground.note: Excels against spread bases, which are common in war.

super_dragon.name: Super Dragons
super_dragon.note: Simple funnel and a straight push; forgiving of imperfect timing.

fireball_yeti.name: Fireball Super Yetis
fireball_yeti.note: Handles compact, stacked cores better than spread bases.

rc_walk_dragons.name: RC Walk Dragons
rc_walk_dragons.note: The Royal Champion removes key defences early; the forgiving TH17 option.

air_spam.name: Electro Dragon spam
air_spam.note: Beginner-friendly, little micromanagement. Broken up by gaps and staggered defences.

hydra.name: Hydra with Totem Spells
hydra.note: The faster air alternative at TH18.

rocket_edrag.name: Rocket E-Drag + Dragon Duke
rocket_edrag.note: Heavy damage with clean pathing; war and Legend.

rc_root_thrower.name: RC Walk Root Rider + Throwers
rc_root_thrower.note: Reported as the primary TH18 strategy for 2026.

barb_rush.name: Barbarian rush
barb_rush.note: The only army available before Archers; nothing to funnel, nothing to tank.

giant_archer_wb.name: Giants + Archers + Wall Breakers
giant_archer_wb.note: Wall Breakers added so the tankline reaches the Mortar quickly.

balloon_archer.name: Balloons + Archers
balloon_archer.note: Air dominates here because anti-air coverage is still limited.

ground_push.name: Full ground army push
ground_push.note: Air becomes inconsistent at this level, so heavy ground is the reliable entry.

mass_dragon.name: Mass Dragons
mass_dragon.note: Reported as one of the easiest strategies in the game at this level.

witch_slap.name: Witch Slap
witch_slap.note: Sustained pressure from multiple Golems and Witches.

zap_lalo.name: Zap LavaLoon
zap_lalo.note: Lightning the Air Defenses, then Lava Hound and Balloons.

falcon.name: Falcon (Queen Charge Valkyries + Bowlers)
falcon.note: Queen charge opens a side, Valkyries and Bowlers clear the core.

zap_witches.name: Zap Witches
zap_witches.note: Spell value combined with strong ground troops.

electro_dragon.name: Electro Dragons
electro_dragon.note: Chain damage; broken up by gaps and staggered defences.

dragbat.name: DragBat
dragbat.note: Hybrid air: remove the splash damage, then release Bats.

super_witch_fireball.name: Super Witch Fireball
super_witch_fireball.note: Fireball clears a key defence ahead of the Super Witches.

yeti_superwiz.name: Yeti + Super Wizard Smash
yeti_superwiz.note: Heavy ground for breaking strong bases.

yeti_superarcher.name: Yeti Super Archer Spam
yeti_superarcher.note: Super Archers behind a Yeti tankline.

sa_clone_hydra.name: Super Archer Clone Hydra
sa_clone_hydra.note: Clone spell extends the Super Archer value.

blimp_dragons.name: Mass Dragons with Battle Blimp
blimp_dragons.note: Adaptability over brute force; the Blimp picks the entry.

sa_blimp_dragons.name: Super Archer Blimp Dragons
sa_blimp_dragons.note: Blimp drops Super Archers into the core, Dragons clean.

hydra_rider.name: Hydra (Dragons, Riders, Blimp)
hydra_rider.note: Emphasises pathing and avoiding the Clan Castle.

warden_yetis.name: Warden Charge Super Yetis
warden_yetis.note: Warden charge ahead of the Yeti push.

fireball_loons.name: Fireball Rocket Loons
fireball_loons.note: Fireball removes a key air defence before the Balloons run.

rc_root_riders.name: RC Charge Root Riders
rc_root_riders.note: Royal Champion opens the side the Root Riders enter.

mass_rc_dragons.name: Mass RC Charge Dragons
mass_rc_dragons.note: Royal Champion charge into a straight dragon push.

air_slice.name: Air Slice
air_slice.note: Cuts one high-value air slice instead of forcing the core.

super_dragon_wagon.name: Super Dragons (Sky Wagon)
super_dragon_wagon.note: Super Dragons with the right setup, timing and pathing control.

duke_bowler.name: Dragon Duke Charge + Super Bowler smash
duke_bowler.note: Described as the most overpowered ground push in the game.

healer_giants.name: Giants + Healers
healer_giants.note: Healers and the Heal Spell make a 12-Giant tankline reliable.

balloon_wizard.name: Mass Balloons + Wizards
balloon_wizard.note: 22 Balloons with Wizard support is a reported TH5 line.
